title.en: Whose Ledger Holds the Realm's Land Dues

mechanics.zh: 玩家选择并可重选试点州；实际核账扣费、财政债务压力、官署就业与供给；保守旧额有较低的真实目标和连续观察；商人垫款在退出后仍须偿还。
mechanics.en: The player chooses and can replace a pilot state. Actual audit charges, fiscal debt pressure, office employment and supply matter. Capped legacy dues have a smaller real goal and continuous review; merchant advances remain payable after exit.

mechanics.zh: 同一实际就业人口的接纳、职位与政治资格；选举和无选举王权分别判断；登记和地方执行费用须真实支付；连续九个月兑现与独立的受阻退出通路。
mechanics.en: Acceptance, employment and political eligibility are checked for actual workers. Electoral and nonelectoral royal institutions use distinct conditions. Registration and local execution must be paid; nine months of fulfillment and separate blocked exits are enforced.

title.en: Military Gates, Tax Rolls and New Offices

mechanics.zh: 真实军法、兵营或边警官署的就业与短缺、军饷和财政安全；六个月加九个月连续观察；缩限承诺对应有限结果；已签译学和转职合同退出后仍按上限偿付。
mechanics.en: Actual army law, barracks or border-office employment and shortages, wages and fiscal safety govern six- and nine-month observations. Narrow commitments yield limited results; signed translation and transition contracts remain bounded obligations after exit.

evidence_limits.zh: 情景证据来自严格脚本子集的离线执行和明确注入的引擎事实，不模拟整场战役。静态定义、可达性图和离线通过不证明真实引擎、存档加载、UI、AI选择、性能或长期平衡。完整1290事件/342日志目标仍未完成。
evidence_limits.en: Scenario evidence executes a strict script subset with explicit engine-fact fixtures, not a campaign simulator. Static definitions, reference graphs and offline results do not establish engine execution, save loading, UI, AI choices, performance or long-term balance. The complete 1290-event/342-journal target is unfinished.
